## Change

Describe the consumer-visible change or maintenance rationale.

## Size

What it deletes; source and test lines added and removed; public names added and removed; any
check added or size exception lowered. A PR that only adds says why.

## Verification

Link exact-head CI and describe any additional checks. Do not inherit old counts.

## Compatibility and safety

Note API/error/ownership changes, dependency changes, and any release impact.
Ordinary CI must not allocate hosted browsers, perform paid inference, or publish.
